fusions.name: Scattered Coals
fusions.desc: Scatters burning coals, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and setting each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Hot Hands
fusions.desc: Tosses a live coal into the first enemy it meets for 9 damage, setting it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Ember Line
fusions.desc: Lays a wall of fire 6 tiles long for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Stolen Warmth
fusions.desc: When you afflict an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
